metadata.source_context: Questions follow EICV7 household concepts, simplified for an accessible screening interface.

general.required: Please provide an answer or select 'I don't know'.

questions.household_composition: How many people, children and elderly people live in the household?
questions.sleeping_rooms: How many rooms are mainly used for sleeping?
questions.floor_material: What is the main floor material?
questions.electricity: Does the household have electricity access?
questions.livestock: Approximately how many livestock does the household own?
questions.mobile_phone: Does anyone in the household have a mobile telephone?
questions.internet: Has anyone in the household used the internet during the last three months?
questions.insurance: How many household members currently have health insurance?
questions.agriculture: Does anyone carry out agricultural or livestock activity?
questions.wage_employment: Does anyone currently work for a wage or salary?
questions.business: Does anyone operate a non-farm business?

results.positive_message: Your answers suggest that a more complete assessment may be helpful. This result does not automatically determine eligibility for assistance.
results.negative_title: No elevated risk detected from this quick screening
results.negative_message: This does not prove that the household is not vulnerable. The quick screen can miss households that need support. You may request a complete assessment.
results.limited_message: Only 60–79% of the questions were answered. Interpret this screening result with additional caution.
results.insufficient_message: Fewer than 60% of the questions were answered. Please provide more information or request assistance.
results.small_household_message: This quick screen has lower sensitivity for households with one to three members. Please request a complete assessment if you have concerns or need support.

safeguards.screening_warning: This is an initial screening result, not an official poverty classification or automatic eligibility decision.
safeguards.privacy_notice: Do not enter names, national identification numbers or telephone numbers. The screening does not require them.
safeguards.human_review: A trained officer should review decisions involving benefits, credit, insurance or public assistance.

general.app_subtitle: Isuzuma ryihuse ry'intege nke z'ubukungu mu rugo

questions.household_composition: Ni abantu bangahe baba muri uru rugo, harimo abana n'abantu bageze mu zabukuru?
questions.sleeping_rooms: Ni ibyumba bingahe bikoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuryamamo?
questions.floor_material: Hasi mu nzu hakozwe mu ki?
questions.mobile_phone: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ufite telefoni igendanwa?
questions.internet: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo wakoresheje interineti mu mezi atatu ashize?
questions.insurance: Ni abantu bangahe muri uru rugo bafite ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima?
questions.agriculture: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ukora ubuhinzi cyangwa ubworozi?
questions.wage_employment: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ukorera umushahara?
questions.business: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ufite ubucuruzi cyangwa undi murimo utari ubuhinzi?

results.positive_title: Hashobora kuba hari intege nke z'ubukungu
results.positive_message: Ibisubizo watanze bigaragaza ko isuzuma rirambuye rishobora gufasha. Ibi ntibihita byemeza ko urugo rwemerewe ubufasha.
results.negative_title: Nta kimenyetso gikomeye cyagaragajwe n'iri suzuma ryihuse
results.negative_message: Ibi ntibivuze ko urugo rudakeneye ubufasha. Iri suzuma rishobora kutabona ingo zimwe zikeneye ubufasha. Ushobora gusaba isuzuma rirambuye.
results.limited_message: Hasubijwe hagati ya 60% na 79% by'ibibazo. Koresha iki gisubizo witonze.
results.insufficient_message: Hasubijwe munsi ya 60% by'ibibazo. Tanga andi makuru cyangwa usabe ubufasha mu kuzuza isuzuma.
results.small_household_message: Iri suzuma ryihuse ntiribona neza intege nke z'ubukungu mu ngo zigizwe n'abantu umwe kugeza kuri batatu. Saba isuzuma rirambuye niba ufite impungenge cyangwa ukeneye ubufasha.

safeguards.screening_warning: Iki ni igisubizo cy'isuzuma ry'ibanze gusa. Si icyemezo cya leta ku cyiciro cy'ubukene kandi ntigihita cyemeza uwemerewe ubufasha.
safeguards.privacy_notice: Ntushyiremo amazina, nimero y'indangamuntu cyangwa nimero ya telefoni. Iri suzuma ntiribikeneye.
safeguards.human_review: Umukozi wabihuguriwe agomba gusuzuma ibyemezo bijyanye n'ubufasha, inguzanyo cyangwa ubwishingizi.
